fitted_from: least squares of cost_usd on (raw_input, cache_creation, cache_read, output_tokens) over 1778 completed claude-sonnet-5-5 rows in results/*/runs.jsonl (result-event totals)
fit_quality: max relative error 2e-15: the reported cost is exactly linear in these four token counts at these rates
caveat: all cache creation in the fitted runs was the 1-hour kind; a different TTL mix would price cache_creation differently. Refit with src/fit-prices.ts if the model or pricing changes.
label: estimate

output_calibration.why: assistant events of a stream-json transcript carry output_tokens as counted when the message started (median 31% of the final count); input-side counts are exact
output_calibration.formula: output_tokens = max(event output_tokens, round(chars_per_token_inv * chars + per_turn * turns)), chars = text + tool_use name + JSON of tool_use input
output_calibration.validated_on: 1778 completed runs, cost from events with the result event removed vs reported cost: ratio p5 0.93, median 1.007, p95 1.06
